input.summary: Implemented an in-memory Task Management API in TypeScript: EventBus, UserService, ProjectService, TaskService, CommentService, NotificationService, HTTP router using Node http, main entrypoint, and demo script. All services use in-memory Maps; inter-service communication via EventBus events. Project builds cleanly (tsc --noEmit). Demo script starts server if needed and exercises create users/projects/tasks, assignment, status changes, comments, and notifications.
